description: This file is a shell script that defines and runs tests related to 'git svn' functionality, involving repository setup, prerequisites checks, and auxiliary functions for manipulating Subversion repositories.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: Executes 'svn' commands with a specified config directory.

methods.name: maybe_start_httpd
methods.description: conditionally starts a local HTTP server for svn testing.

methods.name: convert_to_rev_db
methods.description: Converts a raw input file to a revision database format using Perl script.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Checks if svnserve tests can run based on environment variable.

methods.name: start_svnserve
methods.description: Starts an svnserve process listening on a specified port.

methods.name: prepare_utf8_locale
methods.description: Sets up UTF-8 locale environment for testing.
